title: hivemem: shared knowledge store with pg + bm25
description: PostgreSQL-based knowledge store to replace mulch. BM25 full-text search, stores sessions, accessible from all clients (bot, claude-code, etc). Centralized project memory across all agents and environments.
notes:
Goals: store raw sessions, transcripts, knowledge files. BM25 search across all content. Scheduled AI summarization pipeline over stored data. Replaces mulch flat-file approach with queryable PG store accessible from all clients via MCP.

Additional requirements: rich metadata support — project association, knowledge types (convention, pattern, decision, failure, reference, guide — like mulch), shortlinks for cross-referencing with beads (e.g. hm-abc123 links to bd-xyz). Goal: hivemem becomes the unified backend that mulch and bd both read/write from.

Tagging system: each record gets tags (free-form + structured) so agents searching via BM25 can quickly triage relevance. Tags surface in search results alongside title/snippet. Examples: #streaming #ws #cancel, #deploy #docker #ci. Tags also enable faceted filtering (project + type + tags). This is the key UX improvement over mulch — agents see tags in results and can pick the right record without reading full content.

Search result format: each result returns (shortlink, summary, tags). Agents never need to fetch full content just to decide relevance. Pre-filtering by tags before BM25: project, type, custom tags. Example: search 'cancel' filtered by project:telegram-bot type:decision → only matching subset goes through BM25 ranking. This is the core agent UX: filter → search → scan tags+summary → fetch only what you need.

title: hivemem: provision PostgreSQL with pg_bm25 extension
description: Set up PostgreSQL instance with ParadeDB pg_bm25 extension for full-text search. Docker-based, on-prem. Foundation for the hivemem shared knowledge store.

title: hivemem: MCP Rails server for multi-client access
description: Rails MCP server exposing hivemem over Model Context Protocol. Hosts on-prem, lets all clients (bot, claude-code, agents) read/write the shared knowledge store via MCP tools.
